Event.description: Event identifier for all sediment core samples, constant value AMK75-6150.

Depth sed.description: Sediment depth expressed as a proportion of total core length.

Age.description: Age provides continuous numeric measurement of each sediment cores chronological age.

Diatoms.description: Total diatom count per sediment core sample.

Diatom warm.description: Proportion of warm-water diatom species, expressed as percentage.

Diatoms cold.description: Percentage of cold‑water diatom assemblage in each sediment sample.

Diatoms ice-neritic.description: Relative abundance of ice-neritic diatom taxa in each sediment core sample.

Diatom sea ice.description: Continuous diatom sea ice concentration measurements.

Diatoms sublitt.description: Sub‑littoral diatom abundance values are continuous measurements across sediment core samples.

Diatom fw.description: Diatom fw values are continuous numeric measurements without

Diatom fossil.description: Continuous measurement of diatom fossil abundance in sediment samples.

A. septentrionalis.description: Abundance of A. septentrionalis in each sediment core sample

F. oceanica.description: F. oceanica relative abundance expressed as percentage of total diatom counts.

P. glacialis.description: Measured abundance values for a diatom species in each sediment core sample.

T. gravida.description: Measured abundance of T. gravida in each sediment core sample.

T. nordenskioeldii.description: Relative abundance of a diatom species in sediment samples (fraction of total diatoms).

P. sulcata.description: Measured concentration of P. sulcata in each sediment core sample.

T. angustelineata.description: Measured abundance of T. angustilineata in sediment core samples.

T. baltica.description: Abundance of a diatom species in each core sample.

T. eccentrica.description: Relative abundance of T. eccentrica in each sediment core sample.

A. curvatulus.description: Diatom species abundance expressed as percentage of total counts in each sediment layer.

C. asteromphalus.description: Relative abundance of C. asteromphalus expressed as percentage of total diatom count.

C. radiatus.description: Relative abundance of Cyclotella radiatus in sediment, measured as percent of total diatoms.

S. oestrupii.description: Measured abundance of S. oestrupii in each sediment core sample.

T. nitzschioides.description: Relative abundance of T. nitzschioides in sediment samples, expressed as percentage.

A. islandica.description: Probability of A. islandica presence in each sediment sample.

A. subarctica.description: Relative abundance of a diatom species in sediment, expressed as a proportion.

C. meneghiniana.description: Probability of C. meneghiniana occurrence in each sediment sample.

G. parvulum.description: Abundance of G. parvulum recorded for each sediment core sample.

N. seminae.description: Abundance of N. semina diatom species (counts) per sediment sample.

H. polymorphus.description: Relative abundance of H. polymorphus expressed as percentage.

E. turris.description: Measured abundance of a diatom species in sediment samples.

P. caput-avis var. gracilis.description: Proportion of P. caput-avis var. gracilis present in each sediment core sample.

C. ferox.description: C. ferox abundance in sediment samples (continuous proportion).

T. undulosa.description: Relative abundance of the diatom species in sediment samples (percentage).

Latitude.description: Geographic latitude in decimal degrees for each sediment core location.

Longitude.description: Geographic longitude in decimal degrees for each sediment core location.

Elevation.description: Elevation of sampling site, measured in meters below sea level.

Date/Time.description: Date/Time records the timestamp of each sediment core sampling event.
